headline: The Robot Revolution
intro: Watch the video, read the text about the future of AI, and answer the questions. Practice your Future tenses (plans, predictions, continuous, perfect) and time clauses!

reading.title: The Robot Revolution
reading.subtitle: How will AI change our world?

paragraphs.label: A.
paragraphs.text: Artificial intelligence is no longer science fiction. It is already part of our daily lives. By 2030, AI will have changed our world completely. Tech companies are going to launch even smarter algorithms next year. We are going to see cars that drive themselves and computers that can write essays. This is a huge breakthrough for humanity.

paragraphs.label: B.
paragraphs.text: However, this creates fear. Many people worry that automation will take their jobs. Will robots replace the human workforce? Experts say that while machines will do routine tasks, they will not replace human creativity. Humans are going to adapt. By 2050, the workplace will have changed completely. We will be working alongside robots, not against them.

paragraphs.label: C.
paragraphs.text: There are also ethical questions. It is difficult to predict how AI will behave. If we give machines too much power, will they be dangerous? We must create strict rules. I am meeting an AI developer tomorrow at 10 AM to discuss this. This time next year, governments will be debating new AI laws. By the time the decade ends, we will have established a global framework for AI safety.

paragraphs.label: D.
paragraphs.text: Ultimately, humans are good at one thing: we can adapt. When new technology arrives, we learn how to use it. As soon as we understand AI better, we will use it to solve climate change and diseases. The future isn't something that happens to us; it is something we are going to build.
